test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: An optical device X has a focal length of -30 cm. X can be:

options.text: either concave lens or a convex mirror
either a convex lens or a convex mirror
either a convex lens or a concave mirror
either a concave lens or a concave mirror

solution:
The correct answer is "__**either a concave lens or a concave mirror**__".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In contrast to convex mirrors and **convex lenses**, concave mirrors and concave lenses produce larger pictures.
 
• A hollow **spherical** can be made into a mirror by cutting it into pieces, painting the exterior of each piece, and then polishing the interior to reflect
